naa425c5677.headline: EEC: The economies of the EAEU countries are adapting to global challenges
naa425c5677.summary: The Eurasian Economic Commission chairman stated that EAEU member economies have made significant progress and are adapting to serious global challenges.
naa425c5677.why: The EAEU is a regional economic bloc; its members' adaptation affects regional trade and investment flows.
